meta.title: Ivy Gabriel — development and digital craft
meta.description: Ivy Gabriel's portfolio: websites, interfaces and experiments built with code and care for detail.

hero.title: I build websites and digital products that feel alive.
hero.subtitle: I'm Ivy Gabriel. I develop interfaces, experiments and personal projects, from code to detail.

about.label: About
about.text: I turn ideas into fast, accessible interfaces with personality. I like to start from the problem, design with patience and only then write the code that solves it.

items.title: Websites and web experiences
items.text: I build fast, polished websites from first draft to deploy, with attention to performance and accessibility.

items.title: Interactive interfaces
items.text: I bring interfaces to life with motion, scroll and microinteractions that explain instead of decorate.

items.title: Interface design
items.text: I design screens and consistent visual systems that are ready to become code without surprises.

items.title: Prototypes and experiments
items.text: I test ideas fast with working prototypes, so decisions are made with something in hand and not only on paper.

outro.title: Have an idea to take off the paper?
outro.text: Tell me where you are, what you want to achieve and what is in the way. I reply personally.
